description: This module provides APIs for a WebSub Subscriber Service.

typeDefs.name: SubscriberServiceConfiguration
typeDefs.description: Configuration for a WebSubSubscriber service.

fields.name: target
fields.description:
The `string` resource URL for which discovery will be initiated to identify the hub and topic,
or a tuple `[hub, topic]` representing a discovered hub and a topic

fields.name: leaseSeconds
fields.description: The period for which the subscription is expected to be active

fields.name: callback
fields.description: The callback URL for subscriber-service

fields.name: secret
fields.description: The secret to be used for authenticated content distribution

fields.name: appendServicePath
fields.description: This flag notifies whether or not to append service-path to callback-url

fields.name: unsubscribeOnShutdown
fields.description: This flag notifies whether or not to initiate unsubscription when the service is shutting down

fields.name: httpConfig
fields.description: The configuration for the subscriber client used to interact with the discovered/specified hub

fields.name: discoveryConfig
fields.description: HTTP client configurations for resource discovery

type.name: record {|string|string[] accept?; string|string[] acceptLanguage?; ClientConfiguration httpConfig?;|}

fields.name: customParams
fields.description: Additional parameters, which need to be sent with the subscription/unsubscription request

fields.name: customHeaders
fields.description: Additional HTTP headers, which need to be sent with the subscription/unsubscription request

fields.name: servicePath
fields.description: The generated service-path if the service-path is not provided. This is auto-generated at the compile-time.

typeDefs.description: Record representing a WebSub subscription change request-body.

fields.name: topic

fields.description: The lease period for which the subscription is expected to be active

fields.name: secret

fields.name: customParams
fields.description: Additional parameters which need to be sent with the subscription request

fields.name: customHeaders
fields.description: Additional HTTP headers which need to be sent with the subscription request

typeDefs.name: SubscriptionChangeResponse
typeDefs.description: Record representing subscription/unsubscription details if a subscription/unsubscription request is successful.

fields.name: topic
fields.description: The topic for which the subscription/unsubscription was successful

fields.name: response
fields.description: The response from the hub to the subscription/unsubscription request

typeDefs.name: SubscriberService

typeDefs.name: Listener
typeDefs.description:
Initiliazes `websub:Listener` instance.
```ballerina
listener websub:Listener websubListenerEp = check new (9090);
```

functions.name: init
functions.description:
Initiliazes `websub:Listener` instance.
```ballerina
listener websub:Listener websubListenerEp = check new (9090);
```

parameters.name: listenTo
parameters.description: Port number or a `http:Listener` instance

parameters.name: host
parameters.description: The host name/IP of the endpoint

parameters.name: http1Settings
parameters.description: Configurations related to HTTP/1.x protocol

parameters.name: secureSocket
parameters.description:
The SSL configurations for the service endpoint. This needs to be configured in order to
communicate through HTTPS.

parameters.name: httpVersion
parameters.description: Highest HTTP version supported by the endpoint

parameters.name: timeout
parameters.description:
Period of time in seconds that a connection waits for a read/write operation. Use value 0 to
disable timeout

parameters.name: server
parameters.description: The server name which should appear as a response header

parameters.name: requestLimits
parameters.description: Configurations associated with inbound request size limits

parameters.name: gracefulStopTimeout
parameters.description: Grace period of time in seconds for listener gracefulStop

parameters.name: socketConfig
parameters.description: Provides settings related to server socket configuration

parameters.name: http2InitialWindowSize
parameters.description: Configuration to change the initial window size in HTTP/2

parameters.name: minIdleTimeInStaleState
parameters.description:
Minimum time in seconds for a connection to be kept open which has received a GOAWAY.
This only applies for HTTP/2. Default value is 5 minutes. If the value is set to -1,
the connection will be closed after all in-flight streams are completed

parameters.name: timeBetweenStaleEviction
parameters.description:
Time between the connection stale eviction runs in seconds. This only applies for HTTP/2.
Default value is 30 seconds

parameters.name: gracefulShutdownPeriod
parameters.description: The time period in seconds to wait for unsubscription verification

parameters.name: config
parameters.description: Custom `websub:ListenerConfiguration` to be provided to underlying HTTP Listener

return.description: The `websub:Listener` or an `websub:Error` if the initialization failed

functions.name: attach
functions.description:
Attaches the provided `websub:SubscriberService` to the `websub:Listener`.
```ballerina
check websubListenerEp.attach('service, "/subscriber");
```

parameters.name: name
parameters.description: The path of the Service to be hosted

return.description: An `websub:Error`, if an error occurred during the service attaching process or else `()`

functions.name: attachWithConfig

parameters.name: configuration
parameters.description: Custom `websub:SubscriberServiceConfiguration` which should be incorporated into the provided Service

parameters.name: name
parameters.description: The path of the Service to be hosted

return.description: An `websub:Error`, if an error occurred during the service attaching process or else `()`

functions.name: detach
functions.description:
Detaches the provided `websub:SubscriberService` from the `websub:Listener`.
```ballerina
check websubListenerEp.detach('service);
```

return.description: An `websub:Error`, if an error occurred during the service detaching process or else `()`

functions.name: 'start
functions.description:
Starts the registered service programmatically..
```ballerina
check websubListenerEp.'start();
```

functions.name: gracefulStop
functions.description:
Stops the service listener gracefully. Already-accepted requests will be served before connection closure.
```ballerina
check websubListenerEp.gracefulStop();
```

return.description: An `websub:Error`, if an error occurred during the listener stopping process or else `()`

functions.name: immediateStop
functions.description:
Stops the service listener immediately.
```ballerina
check websubListenerEp.immediateStop();
```

return.description: An `websub:Error`, if an error occurred during the listener stopping process or else `()`

clients.name: DiscoveryService
clients.description: Represents resource-discovery service which identify the `hub` and `topic` from `resource-URL`.

functions.name: init
functions.description:
Initiliazes the `websub:DiscoveryService` endpoint.
```ballerina
websub:DiscoveryService discoveryServiceEp = check new ("https://sample.discovery.com");
```

parameters.name: httpVersion
parameters.description: The HTTP version understood by the client

parameters.name: http1Settings
parameters.description: Configurations related to HTTP/1.x protocol

parameters.name: http2Settings
parameters.description: Configurations related to HTTP/2 protocol

parameters.name: timeout
parameters.description: The maximum time to wait (in seconds) for a response before closing the connection

parameters.name: followRedirects
parameters.description: Configurations associated with Redirection

parameters.name: poolConfig
parameters.description: Configurations associated with request pooling

parameters.name: auth
parameters.description: Configurations related to client authentication

parameters.name: retryConfig
parameters.description: Configurations associated with retrying

parameters.name: responseLimits
parameters.description: Configurations associated with inbound response size limits

parameters.name: secureSocket
parameters.description: SSL/TLS related options

parameters.name: circuitBreaker
parameters.description: Configurations associated with the behaviour of the Circuit Breaker

return.description: The `websub:DiscoveryService` or an `websub:Error` if the initialization failed

functions.name: discoverResourceUrls
functions.description:
Discovers the URLs of the hub and topic defined by a resource URL.
```ballerina
[string, string] discoveryDetails = check discoveryServiceEp->discoverResourceUrls(expectedMediaTypes, expectedLanguageTypes);
```

parameters.name: expectedMediaTypes
parameters.description: The expected media types for the subscriber client

parameters.name: expectedLanguageTypes
parameters.description: The expected language types for the subscriber client

return.description: A `(hub, topic)` as a `(string, string)` if successful or else an `websub:ResourceDiscoveryFailedError` if not

clients.name: SubscriptionClient
clients.description: The HTTP based client for WebSub subscription and unsubscription.

functions.name: init
functions.description:
Initializes the `websub:SubscriptionClient` instance.
```ballerina
websub:SubscriptionClient subscriptionClientEp = check new ("https://sample.hub.com");
```

parameters.name: url
parameters.description: The URL at which the subscription should be changed

parameters.name: httpVersion
parameters.description: The HTTP version understood by the client

parameters.name: http1Settings
parameters.description: Configurations related to HTTP/1.x protocol

parameters.name: http2Settings
parameters.description: Configurations related to HTTP/2 protocol

parameters.name: timeout
parameters.description: The maximum time to wait (in seconds) for a response before closing the connection

parameters.name: followRedirects
parameters.description: Configurations associated with Redirection

parameters.name: poolConfig
parameters.description: Configurations associated with request pooling

parameters.name: auth
parameters.description: Configurations related to client authentication

parameters.name: retryConfig
parameters.description: Configurations associated with retrying

parameters.name: responseLimits
parameters.description: Configurations associated with inbound response size limits

parameters.name: secureSocket
parameters.description: SSL/TLS related options

parameters.name: circuitBreaker
parameters.description: Configurations associated with the behaviour of the Circuit Breaker

parameters.name: config
parameters.description: Optional `ClientConfiguration` for the underlying client

return.description: The `websub:SubscriptionClient` or an `websub:Error` if the initialization failed

functions.name: subscribe
functions.description:
Sends a subscription request to the provided `hub`.
```ballerina
websub:SubscriptionChangeResponse response = check subscriberClientEp->subscribe(subscriptionRequest);
```

parameters.name: subscriptionRequest
parameters.description: The request payload containing the subscription details

return.description:
The `websub:SubscriptionChangeResponse` indicating that the subscription initiation was successful
or else an `websub:SubscriptionInitiationError`

functions.name: unsubscribe
functions.description:
Sends an unsubscription request to a WebSub Hub.
```ballerina
websub:SubscriptionChangeResponse response = check subscriberClientEp->unsubscribe(subscriptionRequest);
```

parameters.name: unsubscriptionRequest
parameters.description: The request payload containing the unsubscription details

return.description:
The `websub:SubscriptionChangeResponse` indicating that the unsubscription initiation was successful
or else an `websub:SubscriptionInitiationError`

functions.name: getHeader
functions.description:
Returns the value of the specified header. If the specified header key maps to multiple values, the first of
these values is returned.

parameters.name: msg
parameters.description: Current `websub:ContentDistributionMessage` object

parameters.name: headerName
parameters.description: The header name

return.description:
The first header value for the specified header name or the `http:HeaderNotFoundError` if the header is not
found.

functions.name: getHeaders
functions.description: Gets all the header values to which the specified header key maps to.

parameters.name: msg
parameters.description: Current `websub:ContentDistributionMessage` object

parameters.name: headerName
parameters.description: The header name

return.description:
The header values the specified header key maps to or the `http:HeaderNotFoundError` if the header is not
found.

parameters.name: listenTo
parameters.description: Port number or a `http:Listener` instance

parameters.name: config
parameters.description: Custom `websub:ListenerConfiguration` to be provided to underlying HTTP Listener

methods.name: onEventNotification
methods.description: Invoked when the hub delivers a content update for a topic this subscriber is subscribed to. This is the handler that does the actual work.

parameters.name: event
parameters.description: The delivered content update, including its payload and the topic it came from.

methods.name: onSubscriptionVerification
methods.description: Invoked when the hub asks this subscriber to confirm an intent to subscribe. Return success to complete the subscription, or an error to reject it.

parameters.name: msg
parameters.description: The hub's verification challenge for the pending subscription.

methods.name: onUnsubscriptionVerification
methods.description: Invoked when the hub asks this subscriber to confirm an intent to unsubscribe.

parameters.name: msg
parameters.description: The hub's verification challenge for the pending unsubscription.

methods.name: onSubscriptionValidationDenied
methods.description: Invoked when the hub refuses a subscription request outright, rather than proceeding to verification.

parameters.name: msg
parameters.description: The hub's stated reason for refusing the subscription.

methods.name: onHubError
methods.description: Invoked when the hub reports a failure to this subscriber.

parameters.name: err
parameters.description: The failure the hub reported.

annotations.name: SubscriberServiceConfig
annotations.description: WebSub Subscriber Configuration for the service, indicating subscription related parameters.
